name: Sumava National Park
story: Sumava National Park is a forest located in Czechia in the South Bohemian regions along the border with Germany and Austria. It protects a little-inhabited mountain range covered by extensive forest and raised peat bogs. Since the 1970s, the park has sheltered a stable population of lynxes.
matters: The park preserves the most extensive forest in Central Europe and features a mosaic of habitats like glacial lakes and primeval forest remnants that are little disturbed by human activity.
